_doc: Training-data processing chain (variant 'podcast'), read by scripts/prep_clean.py. Decided 2026-10-21 by Daniel: train on the podcast-processed voice, with de-essing, gentle compression and normalisation. Reasoning and measurements: docs/voice-profile.md.

denoise.method: noisereduce stationary, the take's own quietest frames as the noise profile

eq._source: Daniel's own voice EQ from his podcast production pipeline, unchanged. ffmpeg filter syntax.

deesser._why: Measured sibilance peak 5.3 kHz, +2 to +3 dB over average speech at 5-6.3 kHz, and the EQ adds +2 dB at 6 kHz. Split-band and dynamic: only the 4.5-9 kHz band, only while it dominates.

compressor._source: The same podcast pipeline's dialogue-bus compressor, applied after normalising the take to the loudness target so the threshold means the same on every take.
